objectives.text: Pay the _monster_ =monster_ a visit in ___mondung_. Reneging on Lady Meridia is fatal.
Go to Meridia's friend _qgfriend_ at __qgfriend_ in ___qgfriend_ for the _artifact_

outcomes.text: =monster_ learned what a broken bargain with Meridia costs, and her _artifact_ is yours.
The days ran out, and Meridia's kindness went unrepaid.

objectives.text: Destroy the _monster_ =monster_ in ___mondung_ for drawing on Molag Bal's power without a contract
=monster_ vanished in a thunderclap. Search ___mondung_ for where the mage fled.
Hunt =monster_ down in ___hideout_ and finish the contract
Meet Molag Bal's agent _contact_ at _tavern_ in __tavern_ for the _artifact_

outcomes.text: =monster_ is dead, the contract is fulfilled, and Molag Bal paid in _artifact_.
The contract lapsed unfulfilled, and Molag Bal never forgets.

objectives.text: Kill the vampire ancient =monster_ in the asylum of ___mondung_. Namira hungers for it.
Go to Namira's friend _qgfriend_ at __qgfriend_ in ___qgfriend_ for your present

outcomes.text: =monster_ is dead, Namira's hunger is sated, and her _artifact_ is yours.
_qgfriend_ would not wait, and Namira's hunger went unfed.

objectives.text: Slay the _monster_ =monster_ in the stronghold of ___mondung_ and ease Nocturnal's pain
Find _bow_, the price of =monster_'s life, in ___bowdung_
Find the _ring_, the price of =monster_'s life, in ___ringdung_
Find the _staff_, the price of =monster_'s life, in ___staffdung_
Meet Nocturnal's slave _qgfriend_ at __qgfriend_ in ___qgfriend_ for the _artifact_

outcomes.text: You took =monster_'s bribe, killed the mage anyway, and still walked off with Nocturnal's _artifact_.
=monster_ is dead, Nocturnal rests easier, and her _artifact_ is yours.
You sold Nocturnal's bargain for =monster_'s bribe, and the mage lives on.
The contract with Nocturnal lapsed unfulfilled.

objectives.text: Send the vampire =monster_ in ___mondung_ on Peryite's one-way trip
Meet Peryite's friend _qgfriend_ at __qgfriend_ in ___qgfriend_ to claim the Spell Breaker

outcomes.text: =monster_ is dead, Peryite's revenge is complete, and the Spell Breaker is yours.
The journey ran past its days, and the Spell Breaker stayed with _qgfriend_.

objectives.text: Murder the battlemage =monster_ fatally in ___mondung_, and do not invite the mage to tea
Find Sheogorath's servant _qgfriend_ in the lunatic asylum ___contactdung_ for the _artifact_

outcomes.text: =monster_ will eat no posy pies now, and Sheogorath's _artifact_ is yours. Do not point it at anyone dear.
_qgfriend_ went off to marry the unknown heir of Rowanda, and took the _artifact_ along.

objectives.text: Rip the heart from the monk =monster_ in the abandoned temple, ___mondung_
Meet Sanguine's agent _contact_ at __contact_ in ___contact_ for the _artifact_

outcomes.text: The pious killjoy =monster_ is dead, the revels can begin again, and Sanguine's _artifact_ is yours.
_contact_ does not like to wait, and Sanguine does not forgive a spoilt game.

objectives.text: Slay the treacherous daedra seducer =monster_ where she hides in ___mondung_
Take _qgfriend_'s note to the Palace of ___ruler_, where _murder_ was killed, or keep Malacath's secret
Meet Malacath's subject _qgfriend_ at the Palace of ___qgfriend_ for the _artifact_

outcomes.text: The seducer is dead, the _artifact_ is yours, and _ruler_ knows who had _murder_ killed.
=monster_ is dead, her secrets with her, and _qgfriend_ handed you Malacath's _artifact_.
The days ran out, and Malacath's hammer stayed in _qgfriend_'s keeping.

objectives.text: Destroy the _monster_ in ___mondung_, the faithless servant who spurned Vaernima
Bring the lich's dust on your hands to _qgfriend_ at __qgfriend_ in ___qgfriend_ for the _artifact_

outcomes.text: The lich is dust, and Vaernima's servant gave you the _artifact_. Your sins will reach Vaernima embellished.
The days ran out, and Vaernima's Skull went to some other corruptible soul.

objectives.text: Silence the priest =monster_, who preaches against vanity in the deserted temple ___mondung_
Scurry to Azura's darling _qgfriend_ at __qgfriend_ in ___qgfriend_ for her Star

outcomes.text: The priest who mocked Azura is dead, and her _artifact_ is yours, though _qgfriend_ was hers first.
The days ran out, and Lady Azura no longer remembers your name.

objectives.text: Butcher the spellsword =monster_ in the fortress of ___mondung_
Find _mfriend_ of ___mfriend_, who warned =monster_ to run
Kill =monster_ in the hiding place _mfriend_ gave up, ___hideout_
Meet Boethiah's agent _qgfriend_ at __qgfriend_ in ___qgfriend_ for the _artifact_

outcomes.text: Charitable =monster_ is butchered, and Boethiah's _artifact_ is yours.
=monster_ lives on, and Boethiah thinks you puny after all.

objectives.text: Exterminate the werewolf preying on Clavicus Vile's friends in ___mondung_
Meet Vile's friend _contact_ at __contact_ in ___contact_ for the _artifact_

outcomes.text: The werewolf is dead, and Clavicus Vile paid as promised: the _artifact_ is yours.
The werewolf outlived Clavicus Vile's deadline, and his offer with it.

objectives.text: Kill _enemy_, who went back on a contract with Hermaeus Mora, in the palace of __palace_
Meet Mora's servant _contact_ in the library at __contact_ in ___contact_ for the _artifact_

outcomes.text: _enemy_ is dead, and the _artifact_ opened its pages to you, but only once.
You spared _enemy_ for a _magic_, and Hermaeus Mora wanted blood, not trinkets.
The days ran out, and the _artifact_ stayed shut to you.

objectives.text: Hunt Hircine's wereboar child to its den in ___mondung_ and end its misery
Meet Hircine's contact _contact_ at __contact_ in ___contact_ for the _artifact_

outcomes.text: The wereboar has had its lesson, the hunt is won, and Hircine's _artifact_ is yours.
The quarry outran the hunter, and Hircine's offer ran out with the days.

objectives.text: Slaughter the frost daedra in ___mondung_, Mehrunes Dagon's straying child
See Dagon's agent _contact_ at _tavern_ in __tavern_ for the _artifact_

outcomes.text: Dagon's prey has returned to Oblivion, and the _artifact_ is yours.
The Mundal nights ran out before you claimed Dagon's _artifact_.

objectives.text: Get into the palace at __palace_ and assassinate the knight _enemy_
Meet Mephala's servant _qgfriend_ at __qgfriend_ in ___qgfriend_ for the _artifact_

outcomes.text: _enemy_ is dead, Mephala is in a better mood, and her _artifact_ is yours.
You were late, as Mephala knew you would be, and the Blade went back to her.
